text: In the cubical library (agda/cubical), the HoTT circle S¹ is defined as:
choices: data S¹ where base : S¹ ; loop : base ≡ base
explanation: S¹ is defined as a higher inductive type: data S¹ where base : S¹ and loop : base ≡ base. This is the standard HIT definition enabled by Cubical Agda's support for HITs.
